amarena: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art material atlas for a top-down 2D digging game. Exactly EIGHT columns by SEVEN rows equal square flush cells, no margins or labels, wide 8:7 sheet. Theme: warm muted burgundy brick wine warehouse, terracotta masonry, oxidized copper pipes, stone lintels, damp red clay. Rich crafted surfaces, broad readable architectural shapes at 64 pixels, consistent soft top-left light, restrained contrast. Orthographic flat material surfaces, no perspective. Row0: eight DISTINCT quiet wall surfaces varying masonry bond or panel structure. Row1: first six cells dark fragmented diggable earth matching the theme, last two quiet wall. Row2: eight different sparse architectural accents: damp patch, riveted plate/stone repair, inset dim lamp, fine crack, vent/root knot, mineral stain, inset niche, aged joint. Row3: first three cells ONE continuous horizontal pipe/root/vein, next three a SECOND continuous lintel/cable/stone band; last two quiet wall. Row4: first three cells a THIRD horizontal structural band, next three a FOURTH different band; last two quiet wall. Row5: two VERTICAL continuous theme supports in columns0 and1 spanning rows4,5,6, and two different vertical supports in columns2 and3 spanning rows4,5,6. IMPORTANT overlapping row4 cols0..3 priority horizontal strips; instead place all FOUR vertical supports in columns4,5,6,7 spanning rows4,5,6. Row6 cols0..3 four corner masonry panels with L-shaped thematic trim. All remaining cells fill quiet matching wall. No characters, items, collectible gems, text, borders, arrows, yellow caution stripes, bright bloom. Walls clearly brighter and more solid than soil. This is an opaque texture atlas, not a scene.
